notes.content:
Hello Core Researchers!

We're excited to announce the Spring Sale and the Spring Theme Skin Giveaway event here at Core Research Lab!

[b]Additional Content Details[/b]

- Title changes to fit the spring theme
- Addition of skins suitable for spring theme (given for free upon logging in until March 31st)
- The newly added spring theme will automatically equip upon the first login after this update.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed an issue where there was no response when selecting a chapter simultaneously with the opening of a new chapter in the outgame.

[b]Level Design Changes[/b]

- Some puzzles have been altered.

[b]Other Changes[/b]

- Some changes to the Xmas Wreath skin.

notes.title: Happy new year!
notes.content:
Hello. This is CandLE!

2023 has passed, and it is now 2024.

Thanks to the considerable interest and feedback from users last year, we were able to put in more effort.

There are still many areas for improvement, but in 2024, we will strive to show more progress. Please look forward to the official release of Pygmalion, which will be updated this year.


[h3][b]Patch 0.2.2[/b][/h3]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Addressed issue where the game wouldn't exit the logo screen.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Removed Christmas theme.
- Removed default distribution of Christmas skins.


We will soon reveal the roadmap for 2024.

Wishing you only good things in the new year.

Happy new year!

notes.title: Dev Log (December 6th)
notes.content:
Hello. This is CandLE, always open.

This time, our game participated in Burning Beaver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/5e64b3fb9af614cf5f0b4fb5e4a94c421bd29661.png[/img]

It's the last exhibition of the year, and it felt different as it was our first event after early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/fdb952f2fe7c8f1deb6b4030fb56a5a4559d5c13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/93e60392daa1fb6e2851ea91c51ac12b1a518caf.png[/img]

Personally, Burning Beaver was a highly satisfying event. Being based in Seoul, we enjoyed the convenient location and appreciated the support provided for accommodations and rest areas, showing great consideration for creators. It was also great to see the event organizers putting effort into various activities and contests using their own goods to enhance the overall exhibition experience.

While there were inevitably some shortcomings during preparation, the feedback was prompt, and even for the second edition, it was enjoyable and well-organized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/e18ba62db45ae15c092049499f0a01d1d43b9c89.png[/img]

Honestly, we were more worried about the number of attendees than the preparation, but it turned out that there were more people than expected.

Especially for Sanabi, the line for purchasing goods was so long that staff had to intervene. The goods were sold out on the second day, and on the third day, fans left messages and drawings on a panel that said the goods were sold out.

Moreover, there were users dressed up as the protagonist, and seeing that, we felt both respect for their efforts and motivation to work harder ourselves. (For reference, we think cosplaying our game's protagonist is quite easy. Just wear glasses, a doctor's gown, and a checkered shirt.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/39e1c1510ad468f638602bea38638dc4ff5b0cda.png[/img]

On the last day, we were honored to receive the Burning Beaver Award for this year.

All those who received awards are remarkable individuals, and I even had thoughts like, "Do I deserve to be among them?" Nevertheless, we consider it as encouragement from those who support us, and we will strive harder.

Thank you to everyone who visited again.

Below are some feedback and improvements we are considering, not only from this exhibition but also from various channels since the early access release.

- Apply timer settings in the clear screen.
- Create convenience buttons in the story part (text effect settings, text log, auto function, etc.).
- Improve quick puzzle map generation on the pad (sometimes it doesn't work).
- Update Spanish UI.
- Voice preview feature in settings.
- Allow option modification during puzzles.
- Improve clear screen production.
- Add resolutions.
- Modify filter design for color separation intuitiveness.
- Standardize mouse pointer size.
- Enhance story script production.
- Add and modify various skins.
- Backup save data.
- Improve store guidance.
- Remove filter animation upon clearing.
- Fix cursor bugs.

In summary, these are the improvements we are considering. We don't know if we can apply and modify everything, but, as per our team's slogan, we will make efforts to show any improved aspects with an open mindset.

In addition, there's a long way to go for the official release, such as creating Episode 3, revealing side stories, and customizing maps.

We plan to share a detailed roadmap for this around the end of December or early January.

Thank you.

CandLE is always open.

notes.title: Pygmalion Patch 0.1.8v
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

- Addressed the runtime error issue preventing the game from running on certain Windows systems.
- Fixed the issue where dialogue conclusions during story progression were displayed with a cursor icon instead of the correct mouse cursor.
- Resolved the problem where the game failed to read Twitch ID values.
- Corrected the cursor direction inconsistency when navigating with keyboard inputs.
- Fixed the abnormal cursor movement on the title screen.

Additional Changes

- Implemented a 3-second command disablement after puzzle manipulation, considering Twitch broadcast delay.
- If the time display option is deactivated, it will also be disabled in the results screen.

notes.title: Pygmalion Demo Update (Sep 28, 2023)
notes.content:
- Some bug fixes have been implemented.

UI layer order has been changed.
The issue where UI colors did not change when the color was modified has been resolved.

- Voiceovers have been added to the characters.

Protagonist: CV (Character Voice) - Voice Actor: Lim Ha Muk
Selena: CV - Voice Actor: Lim Seung Mi
AI Prototype: CV - Voice Actor: Jung Yoo Jung
(If you can't hear the voice, try adjusting the sound settings in the settings menu.)

- Mouse sensitivity settings have been adjusted for improved accuracy.

For users using the existing mouse, it is recommended to change the sensitivity setting from "High" to "Medium" in "Settings > Controls > Sensitivity."

- Story translations have been revised.

Translations have been made more natural, reducing awkwardness.
(For feedback or if you have concerns about the translations, please contact us on Discord.)

- Cinematic enhancements have been added.

notes.title: Pygmalion Demo Update (September 8th, 2023)
notes.content:
[b]Story modification and additional scenes in puzzle[/b]

To enhance the integration between puzzles and the story, a new storyline has been introduced. Additionally, storytelling and guidance within puzzle gameplay have been added to explain puzzle mechanics and rules.


[b]Background change[/b]

The background image has been replaced with a new one.


[b]Puzzle difficulty adjustment[/b]

Many users found the early stages of the puzzles, especially in story mode, to be too easy. As a result, the overall puzzle difficulty has been slightly increased. (Stages that have already been cleared will remain marked as cleared.)


[b]UI modification and addition of detailed functions[/b]

Now, when you select a button, the button will be highlighted.
The UI with language-specific translations has been applied.
The volume control button has been modified to a bar-shaped one for more precise volume control.
(We plan to separate character voices and sound effects in the future)
You can now turn off the in-game timer.
Various minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Pygmalion 4th Quarter Roadmap (+ Development Status)
notes.content:
Hello, researchers!

We are excited to share the development progress and roadmap for the 4th quarter of Pygmalion.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/d84e12942b8ed9396f6cfd3faecffdc2fb7bf480.png[/img]

[h3]~ August[/h3]

Since the release of our free trial version in June, many of you have played Pygmalion and provided valuable feedback. Thank you for your support.

Here are some of the ongoing tasks based on your feedback:

[list]
[*] Bug fixes

[*] UI improvements (settings interface)

[*] Additional resources creation (backgrounds and illustrations enhancement)

[*] Story text revisions

[*] We've also been working on enriching the game's content, including voice recording, adding puzzle stages, and adjusting level designs to enhance your gaming experience.
[/list]

[b]Participation in BIC Exhibition[/b]

We also participated in the BIC Exhibition held in Busan from August 25th to 27th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/7499b17d1242cced54baac902bebad5045bb77ec.gif[/img]

We showcased a preview of the upcoming version of Pygmalion, 

which received a positive response, leading to our nomination in the Casual Games category.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/7eaf13b0f19b690e4361cc9259c533c7e50a7b20.png[/img]


[h3]~ September[/h3]

We will sequentially apply the work we've done until the Early Access launch, and we are actively incorporating feedback to improve the game's quality.

[b]Participation in Tokyo Game Show[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/11a007223e5169873f4abc9c01e2b897d6e2a6be.jpg[/img]

Candle's Pygmalion has been selected as one of the 80 selected indies at the 2023 Tokyo Game Show. We will be exhibiting from the 21st to the 24th at Tokyo Makuhari Messe. We appreciate your interest and support.


[h3]~ October[/h3]

In early October, we plan to release the Early Access version of Pygmalion. It will include content up to Episode 1, and here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] - Story Mode: 70 puzzle stages & story episodes

[*] - Puzzle Mode: 105 normal puzzle stages & 105 hard mode puzzle stages
[/list]

In total, we will be releasing 280 puzzles and 70 episodes. We are also preparing for the translation of story text. We will provide more details through a separate announcement.


[h3]~ December[/h3]

After incorporating feedback received during Early Access, we will proceed with the development of Episode 2, aiming for the official release. Pricing and content details will be announced later.

Thank you for your ongoing interest in Pygmalion. We look forward to sharing updates with you soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772002/9df98f7f05894aeb89b510fadba6578c3c95fd2d.png[/img]
[b]Candle is always open.🕯️[/b]
